license_required.quote: A person practicing or offering to practice registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nursing in the state shall submit evidence of qualification to practice and shall be licensed under this chapter.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development
umbrella_agency.quote: "department" means the Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development

degree_required.value: Accredited nursing education program (registered nurse, practical nurse, or advanced practice registered nurse program)
degree_required.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a registered nurse education program accredited by a national nursing accrediting body and approved by the board

accrediting_body.quote: a registered nurse education program accredited by a national nursing accrediting body and approved by the board

exams.name: Registered or practical nursing licensing examination
exams.quote: registered or practical nursing shall pass a registered nursing or practical nursing licensing examination as prescribed by the board

exams.name: Advanced practice registered nursing certification examination
exams.quote: advanced practice registered nursing shall pass an advanced practice registered nursing certification examination as prescribed by the board

interval_years.quote: Licenses shall be renewed biennially on the dates set by the department with the approval of the respective board.

required.quote: A license to practice nursing may not be renewed unless the nurse has complied with continuing competence requirements established by the board by regulation.

hours_per_period.quote: the regulations must require that a licensee receive not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license

period_years.quote: not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license

value: pain management and opioid use and addiction
topical_requirements.quote: not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license unless the licensee has demonstrated to the satisfaction of the board that the licensee does not currently hold a valid federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number

available.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to practice as a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse, whichever is appropriate, to an applicant who has worked as a nurse within the past five years if the applicant is licensed as a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse under the laws of another state

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another state and meet Alaska qualifications; if not worked as nurse in past five years, must also meet continuing competency requirements or complete a board-approved course of study.
requirements.quote: the board may issue a license by endorsement to practice as a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse, whichever is appropriate, to an applicant who has not worked as a nurse within the past five years if the applicant meets the requirements of (a) of this section and (1) meets the continuing competency requirements of the board; or (2) completes a course of study approved by the board.

regulatory_model.quote: A person practicing or offering to practice registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nursing in the state shall submit evidence of qualification to practice and shall be licensed under this chapter.

credential_type.quote: examine, license, and renew the licenses of qualified applicants

is_mandatory.quote: practice or offer to practice nursing without a license, unless the person is practicing within the scope of a delegation properly made under AS 08.68.805 or is giving necessary aid to the ill, injured, or infirm in an emergency

title_protection.quote: use in connection with the person's name a designation that implies that the person is a licensed nurse unless the person is licensed

scope_protection.quote: It is a class B misdemeanor for a person to ... practice or offer to practice nursing without a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained or attempted to obtain a nursing license by fraud or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has obtained or attempted to obtain a license to practice nursing by fraud or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony or other crime substantially related to nursing qualifications, functions, or duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been convicted of a felony or other crime if the felony or other crime is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitually abuses alcoholic beverages or illegally uses controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitually abuses alcoholic beverages, or illegally uses controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonated a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has impersonated a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally or negligently engaged in conduct resulting in significant risk to client health/safety or injury to a client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has intentionally or negligently engaged in conduct that has resulted in a significant risk to the health or safety of a client or in injury to a client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practices or attempts to practice nursing while afflicted with physical or mental illness, deterioration, or disability interfering with nursing functions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practices or attempts to practice nursing while afflicted with physical or mental illness, deterioration, or disability that interferes with the individual's performance of nursing functions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by regulations adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violated a provision of this chapter or regulations adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has wilfully or repeatedly violated a provision of this chapter or regulations adopted under this chapter or AS 08.01

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denies care or treatment to a patient solely because the patient refuses to agree to arbitrate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: denies care or treatment to a patient or person seeking assistance if the sole reason for the denial is the failure or refusal of the patient or person seeking assistance to agree to arbitrate as provided in AS 09.55.535(a)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized under AS 08.68.705
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized under AS 08.68.705

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of a law, regardless of whether there has been a criminal action or harm to the patient

definition_quote.value: practice of registered nursing means the performance for compensation or personal profit of acts of professional service that requires substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the principles of biological, physiological, behavioral, and sociological sciences in assessing and responding to the health needs of individuals, families, or communities
definition_quote.quote: "practice of registered nursing" means the performance for compensation or personal profit of acts of professional service that requires substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the principles of biological, physiological, behavioral, and sociological sciences in assessing and responding to the health needs of individuals, families, or communities

value: assessment of problems, counseling, and teaching clients to maintain health or prevent illness and in the care of the ill, injured, or infirm
administration, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice
teaching others the skills of nursing
execution of a medical regimen as prescribed by a person authorized by the state to practice medicine
performance of other acts recognized by the nursing profession as properly performed by registered nurses
performance of acts of medical diagnosis and the prescription of medical therapeutic or corrective measures under regulations adopted by the board (for APRN)
methods_authorized.quote: services that include (A) assessment of problems, counseling, and teaching ... (B) administration, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice; (C) teaching others the skills of nursing; (D) execution of a medical regimen as prescribed by a person authorized by the state to practice medicine; (E) performance of other acts that require education and training that are recognized by the nursing profession as properly performed by registered nurses; (F) performance of acts of medical diagnosis and the prescription of medical therapeutic or corrective measures under regulations adopted by the board

drug_authority.value: Advanced practice registered nurses may prescribe and dispense medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures; opioid prescriptions limited to 7-day supply initially; controlled substance prescribing authorized under board regulations and DEA registration
drug_authority.quote: "advanced practice registered nurse" means a registered nurse licensed to practice in the state who, because of specialized education and experience, is certified to perform acts of medical diagnosis and the prescription and dispensing of medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures under regulations adopted by the board

license_tiers.quote: A person practicing or offering to practice registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nursing in the state shall submit evidence of qualification to practice and shall be licensed under this chapter.

aprn_role_categories.quote: requirements for an advanced practice registered nurse to practice as a certified registered nurse anesthetist, certified clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse practitioner, or certified nurse midwife

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: A practical nurse shall work under the supervision of a licensed registered or advanced practice registered nurse, a licensed physician, a licensed physician assistant, or a licensed dentist.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Initial opioid prescription for adult outpatient use may not exceed 7-day supply; opioid prescription for a minor may not exceed 7-day supply; exceptions exist for chronic pain, cancer, palliative care, or logistical/travel barriers.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may not issue (1) an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use; (2) a prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to a minor

dea_registration_required.quote: require that a licensed advanced practice registered nurse who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database under AS 17.30.200(n)

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: require that a licensed advanced practice registered nurse who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database under AS 17.30.200(n)

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The board shall maintain a registry of certified nurse aides.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse licensed under this chapter may delegate nursing duties to other persons, including unlicensed assistive personnel, under regulations adopted by the board.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: An employer of a nurse licensed under this chapter or a nurse aide certified under this chapter practicing within the scope of that license or certification that discharges or suspends a nurse or nurse aide or conditions or restricts the practice of a nurse or nurse aide shall, within seven working days after the action, report to the board the name and address of the person and the reason for the action.

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: An employer may not discharge, threaten, or otherwise discriminate against a nurse employed by the employer regarding the nurse's compensation, terms, conditions, location, or privileges of employment for the nurse's refusal to perform a task involving nursing care delegated to the nurse by the nurse's superior

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: A registered nurse licensed under this chapter may make a determination and pronouncement of death of a person under the following circumstances

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An APRN licensed under AS 08.68 may prescribe, dispense, or administer through telehealth a controlled substance if compliant with state and federal law; an APRN may not prescribe in response to an Internet questionnaire or email to a person without a prior provider-patient relationship.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: an advanced practice registered nurse may not prescribe, dispense, or administer a prescription drug in response to an Internet questionnaire or electronic mail message to a person with whom the advanced practice registered nurse does not have a prior provider-patient relationship

military_education_credit_required.quote: the department or applicable board shall accept military education, training, and service for some or all of the qualifications otherwise required of an applicant for a license or certificate issued under this chapter if (1) the department or applicable board determines that the military education, training, and service is substantially equivalent to some or all of the qualifications otherwise required
